Title: The VP550 PLUS is the Non Modular PSU and best power supply with 550W/120mm silent fan/3-Year Warranty - Antec
URL: https://antec.com/product/power/vp550-plus
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
The VP550 PLUS is the Non Modular PSU and best power supply with 550W/120mm silent fan/3-Year Warranty - Antec

VALUE POWER 550 PLUS

The new generation of VP550 PLUS is crafted for quality, performance and incredible value.

This entry-level solution is rated from 500W to 650W, saving energy through its high efficiency of up to 85% efficient and is 80 PLUS® Standard certified. 

 

Delivering up to 85% efficiency, the VP PLUS series utilizes active PFC, and provides efficiency during max and low loads—living up to the performance standards that we are known for.

 

3 Year Warranty: We stand by the quality and safety of the VP PLUS Power Supplies, offering a 3-year parts and labor warranty and unlimited access to our incomparable technical support and customer service.

 

Efficiency Load: AC INPUT: 100-240V

 

 

120 mm

Silent Fan

The 120 mm Silent Fan is ideal for quiet computing and is designed for longer life, guaranteeing hours of operation.

Features a Thermal Manager, an advanced low voltage fan control for optimal heat & noise management andwill allow your PSU to stay at an optimal temperature. 

Single 12V Rail Design

 

Cable Qty & length

 

 

FEATURES

- Continuous Power - Guaranteed 550W Continuous Power from Antec
- 80 PLUS® certified - Up to 85% efficient, to reduce your electricity bill
- AQ3 - Antec Quality 3 year warranty
- 120mm Silent Fan
- Thermal Manager - An advanced low voltage fan control for optimal heat & noise management
- CircuitShield™ - Full suite of industrial grade protections: UVP/OVP/SCP/OPP/NLO
- Multi PCI-E - 2 PCI-E connectors for multiple GPU support
